svg.aria-label: IntelliSat end-to-end flowchart. Reset_Handler calls main(), which runs init_init() (clocks to 80 MHz, RTC on LSI) and then init_platform() (FPU, console UART, both IMUs, both magnetometers, sun sensors, LEDs, DMA, watchdogs, TIM7 heartbeat). A compile-time #if then runs one hardware test (RUN_TEST=1 and TEST_ID not 0), the unit tests (RUN_UNIT_TESTS=1 and RUN_TEST=0), or by default while(1), where only interrupts such as the TIM7 heartbeat and the TIM3 watchdog kick keep running. The branch_main() call that would start the FreeRTOS scheduler is commented out, so the kernel, the empty mission-mode tasks and the ADCS_MAIN entry point are not reached in the flight build; nothing calls ADCS_MAIN yet. The tickless-idle hook drives PWR and the RTC wakeup. ADCS control (B-dot, PID, ramp) and determination (TRIAD with IGRF, SGP4, SPA, NOVAS) reach hardware only through the virtual_intellisat bridge, where gyro reads and timing are implemented, the HDD PWM call only partly, and magnetometer, sun sensor, coil, epoch and TLE calls are stubs. Device drivers use the register-level system drivers and talk to the IMUs over SPI, magnetometers and panel monitors over software I2C (magnetometer reads always go to MAG1), photodiodes over ADC2 and ADC3, HDD ESCs over PWM on TIM1 and TIM2, the magnetorquer MCU over USART2 and the radio board over USART1, both two-way at 9600 baud with CRC; the radio board carries downlink and commands to and from the ground station. The TIM6 experiment logger is set for 100 ms and started only by its hardware test, no log callback is registered, and the logging records, flash and FRAM storage are declared only.
svg.text: Today the flight build boots, sets up its drivers and idles in while(1); every dashed part is roadmap.
